No core growth guidance in the release.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS from continuing ops (non-GAAP) adds back pretax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (tax-effected in the aggregate 'Tax effect' line) plus gains/charges deemed non-recurring (sale of investments, restructuring plans fundamentally different from ongoing DBS productivity, acquisition-related items, early extinguishment of debt) and discrete tax items. From 2017 (ASU 2016-09) equity-compensation excess tax benefits above ~$10m/quarter anticipated are excluded. No adjusted operating profit or margin is published. Item after-tax amounts are from the release footnotes. Q1-18: $17m excess tax benefit realized vs $10m anticipated; the $7m excess was offset by discrete tax charges, so no discrete adjustment. Release free cash flow table: operating cash flow 828.9 - capex 137.9 + disposals 0.4 = FCF 691.4 (Q1-17: 560.2 - 158.6 + 0.7 = 402.3); FCF/net earnings conversion 1.22.
